result.stdout:
dt-docs: build and lint a project docs site.

Usage:
  dt-docs init [<dir>] [options]    Create a project docs repo
  dt-docs dev [options]             Serve the site locally, reloading as you edit
  dt-docs lint [--format <f>]       Lint the settings, pages and keys
  dt-docs build [--format <f>]      Lint, then build the site into build/, its access rules included
  dt-docs serve [options]           Serve the last build, with search
  dt-docs agent [options]           Answer a deployed site's chat window from this machine
  dt-docs new <kind> <page>         Create a page from a page template
  dt-docs pages                     Print every page's path, title and description, by section
  dt-docs find [<key>]              Print where a key is defined, or every key starting with it
  dt-docs guide [<topic>]           Print the writing guide for a kind of page
  dt-docs --version                 Print the tool's version

Run every command but init in the repo, or below it: the tool finds docs-settings.yml above the current
directory. Options after dev and serve go to Docusaurus unchanged, for example --port 3001. A port
in docs-settings.yml sets the one they use when the command line doesn't name one.

init takes --name, --description, --sections, --ci, --repo-url, --branch, --auth and --tenant-id, and asks
for any it isn't given. --sections is a comma-separated list of folders, each with an optional label:
domain,systems=Acme Systems,features. --ci is github, azure or none. --auth is entra, the default, or
none, which leaves access to the host and takes no --tenant-id.

A key marks a spot on a page: write :def[DOM-HND-04] there, and :ref[DOM-HND-04] on any page links to it.
On the site, /go/DOM-HND-04 opens the page at that spot.

agent answers the chat window of the site at url in docs-settings.yml, built with agent.endpoint set to
where this listens. It takes --port (3100), --host (127.0.0.1; 0.0.0.0 in a container) and --origin, the
site's address when it isn't url. Readers type the passcode in DT_DOCS_AGENT_PA
[truncated]
